description: MUTATES the authenticated user favorite tracks list at /music. Use when they favorite or save a song — do not store this as a chat memory or in music_preferences. Example: “Henry Mancini - Piano And Strings (1995 Remastered)” → log_favorite_song({ track: "Henry Mancini - Piano And Strings (1995 Remastered)" }) or title + artist. Optional year_note, source_url. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

artist.description: Artist name (required unless track blob parses)

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

title.description: Track title (required unless track blob parses)

name: log_favorite_song

created.description: True when a new favorite was created.

title: Log Favorite Song (music write)
